block.prompt: Read the statements below. Decide whether each one is TRUE or FALSE according to Text A, and write one sentence from the text that justifies your answer.

statements: The writer has lived in their building for more than a decade.
The survey mentioned in the text found that older adults feel lonelier than young adults.
Amsterdam and Vienna are trying to redesign parts of their cities to encourage social contact.
According to the writer, people on public transport are rude to each other.
The writer believes that cities cause loneliness.

block.answer_key: 1. TRUE — "I have lived in London for eleven years." 2. FALSE — The text says the figure "rises sharply among 18- to 34-year-olds," meaning young adults feel lonelier than older ones. 3. TRUE — "City planners in Amsterdam and Vienna have recently begun experimenting with what they call 'social infrastructure'." 4. FALSE — The writer explicitly says "This is not rudeness; it is a coping mechanism." 5. FALSE — The writer concludes: "The city does not make us lonely. It makes us overwhelmed."
block.acceptable_reasoning: Für Statement 2 ist eine Fehlinterpretation häufig (siehe watch_outs). Akzeptiere jede Antwort, die erkennt, dass Jüngere höhere Einsamkeitswerte haben als ältere Kohorten.
watch_outs: Statement 2 ist eine häufige Falle: 'rises sharply among 18- to 34-year-olds' bedeutet, dass junge Erwachsene einsamer sind als ältere — der Gegensatz zu Erwartung. Schüler:innen verwechseln oft Subjekt und Referenzgruppe des Vergleichs.
Schüler:innen neigen dazu, die Begründung mit eigenen Worten zu formulieren statt eine Textstelle zu zitieren. Aufgabenstellung nochmals klären.
